items.citation_text: Announcement from the Chair, NYGH Board of Governors re: President & CEO (nygh.on)
items.verbatim_snippet: Karyn Popovich announced her retirement after more than 40 years as a health-system leader, nurse, teacher and mentor. She remained President and CEO during the search and transition period, with NYGH indicating that a successor was expected by mid-fall 2023. Popovich had served as NYGH President and CEO since October 2020.

items.citation_text: Dr. Everton Gooden Appointed New President and CEO of North York General Hospital (nygh.on)
items.verbatim_snippet: NYGH appointed Dr. Everton Gooden as its next President and CEO following a formal search. Gooden had been associated with NYGH for more than 20 years and had held several clinical and physician-leadership positions, including Chair of the Medical Advisory Committee, President of the Medical Staff Association and Division Chief of Head and Neck Surgery. He succeeded Karyn Popovich.

items.citation_text: North York General Hospital welcomes Mitch Frazer as new Chair of Board of Governors (nygh.on)
items.verbatim_snippet: Mitch Frazer was elected Chair of the NYGH Board of Governors at the hospital's June 17, 2024 Annual General Meeting. He had joined the board in 2018 and most recently served as Vice Chair. Frazer replaced Bert Clark after Clark's three-year term as Chair. Clark continued his association with the organization through the North York General Foundation board.

items.role: Vice President, Quality, Post-Acute Care & Community Integration
items.citation_text: Announcing North York General's New Vice President, Quality, Post-Acute Care & Community Integration (nygh.on)
items.verbatim_snippet: Jennifer Dockery was appointed to NYGH's newly created executive portfolio, beginning August 19, 2024. The role provides strategic and operational leadership for quality, risk and ethics, ambulatory programs, the Reactivation Care Centre, seniors' care, long-term-care development and partnerships across home, community and primary care.

items.role: Vice President, Finance, Data Analytics and Chief Financial Officer
items.citation_text: Welcoming Paul Truscott as NYGH's new Vice President Finance, Data Analytics & Chief Financial Officer (nygh.on)
items.verbatim_snippet: Paul Truscott Jr. joined NYGH from Health Sciences North, where he had been Senior Vice President and Chief Operating Officer. He assumed responsibility for finance, data analytics and the CFO portfolio, supporting NYGH's transformation, growth, capital planning and financial sustainability. NYGH thanked Peter Wegener for serving as Interim CFO and supporting the transition.

items.role: Vice President, Clinical Services and Chief Nursing Executive
items.citation_text: Announcing North York General's New Vice President, Clinical Services and Chief Nursing Executive (nygh.on)
items.verbatim_snippet: Terri Stuart-McEwan was appointed to lead NYGH's acute care and specialized services, nursing professional practice and interprofessional-care development. She succeeded Linda Jussaume, who had served as Interim Vice President, Clinical Services and Chief Nursing Executive for approximately one year.

items.role: Interim Vice President, Clinical Services and Chief Nursing Executive
items.citation_text: Announcing North York General's New Vice President, Clinical Services and Chief Nursing Executive (nygh.on)
items.verbatim_snippet: She succeeded Linda Jussaume, who had served as Interim Vice President, Clinical Services and Chief Nursing Executive for approximately one year. NYGH specifically credited Jussaume with guiding the organization through its accreditation process.

items.role: Vice President, Medical Affairs, Research and Education
items.citation_text: Welcoming Dr. Richard Bowry to his new role as NYGH's Vice President, Medical Affairs, Research and Education (nygh.on)
items.verbatim_snippet: Dr. Richard Bowry was appointed to lead NYGH's integrated medical, education and research portfolio. A long-serving NYGH anesthesiologist and physician leader, Bowry had previously served as Chief of Anaesthesia, Chair of the Credentials Committee and Vice Chair of the Medical Advisory Committee. He succeeded Dr. Lloyd Smith, who had served as Interim Vice President of Medical and Academic Affairs for the preceding 14 months.
